mapper.select: SELECT t.id, t.user_id, t.transaction_date, t.merchant, t.category_id, c.name AS category_name, t.amount, t.card_name, t.installment, t.status, t.memo, t.tag, t.is_classified, t.applied_rule_id, TRUE AS persisted FROM transactions t LEFT JOIN categories c ON t.category_id = c.id AND (c.user_id IS NULL OR c.user_id = t.user_id) WHERE t.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY t.transaction_date DESC, t.id DESC

SELECT t.id, t.user_id, t.transaction_date, t.merchant, t.category_id, c.name AS category_name, t.amount, t.card_name, t.installment, t.status, t.memo, t.tag, t.is_classified, t.applied_rule_id, TRUE AS persisted FROM transactions t LEFT JOIN categories c ON t.category_id = c.id AND (c.user_id IS NULL OR c.user_id = t.user_id) WHERE t.id = #{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO transactions (user_id, transaction_date, merchant, category_id, amount, card_name, installment, status, memo, tag, is_classified) VALUES (#{userId}, CAST(#{transactionDate} AS DATE), #{merchant}, #{categoryId,jdbcType=BIGINT}, #{amount}, #{cardName}, #{installment}, #{status}, #{memo}, #{tag}, CASE WHEN #{categoryId,jdbcType=BIGINT} IS NULL THEN FALSE ELSE TRUE END)

INSERT INTO transactions (user_id, transaction_date, merchant, category_id, amount, card_name, installment, status, memo, tag, is_classified) VALUES (#{userId}, CAST(#{transactionDate} AS DATE), #{merchant}, #{categoryId,jdbcType=BIGINT}, #{amount}, #{cardName}, #{installment}, #{status}, #{memo}, #{tag}, CASE WHEN #{categoryId,jdbcType=BIGINT} IS NULL THEN FALSE ELSE TRUE END) ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING
mapper.update: UPDATE transactions SET transaction_date = CAST(#{transactionDate} AS DATE), merchant = #{merchant}, category_id = #{categoryId,jdbcType=BIGINT}, amount = #{amount}, card_name = #{cardName}, installment = #{installment}, status = #{status}, memo = #{memo}, tag = #{tag}, is_classified = CASE WHEN #{categoryId,jdbcType=BIGINT} IS NULL THEN FALSE ELSE TRUE END, applied_rule_id = #{appliedRuleId,jdbcType=BIGINT}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE transactions SET category_id = #{categoryId}, is_classified = TRUE, applied_rule_id = NULL, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE transactions SET tag = #{tag}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
